about: A charge move says its attack message on the charge turn, then its line, as the latest games do (TryChargeTurn, subscript 473). Falkner's scenario, the Raichu given Insomnia, so that the Hoothoot's Hypnosis ends no charge, and taught each move in the running battle: Fly flies up and hits the next turn; Freeze Shock says the line its move script never buffered; Skull Bash with a Power Herb tucks in its head, raises its Defense and spends the herb before the hit, all in one turn.

lines: Raichu became cloaked in a freezing light!
Raichu became fully charged due to its Power Herb!
